# Synthetic order workflow

This independent teaching fixture has no Galaxy, organization, bridge, account or runtime prerequisite.
It describes a small order intake, normalization and report workflow. The source is never executed by DiagramCloud.

Input: illustrative order records. Contribution: separate admission, transformation and explanation.
Output: a declared report shape. Constraint: imports establish static dependencies, not runtime lineage or successful delivery.
Runtime, deployment, duration, throughput and business results are unknown. No observation or verification receipt is supplied.

See [the source index](sources.csv) and [the workflow explanation](docs/workflow.md).
[Missing runtime evidence](docs/runtime-receipt.md) is deliberately unresolved.
